title: Vowels & Consonants
objective: Learn the 5 vowels (A E I O U) and understand how they differ from consonants.
objectiveZh: 学习5个元音（A E I O U），理解它们与辅音的区别。
grammar:
VOWELS vs CONSONANTS 元音与辅音

The English alphabet has 26 letters.
There are TWO types:

🔵 VOWELS (元音) — 5 letters:
A  E  I  O  U
These are OPEN sounds — your mouth stays open and air flows freely.
Try saying them: Ahhh... Ehhh... Ihhh... Ohhh... Uhhh...

🟢 CONSONANTS (辅音) — 21 letters:
B C D F G H J K L M N P Q R S T V W X Y Z
These are CLOSED sounds — your lips, teeth or tongue stop the air.
Try: B (lips close), S (teeth together), T (tongue taps roof of mouth)

💡 KEY RULE: Every English word MUST have at least one vowel!
cat ✅ (a), run ✅ (u), elephant ✅ (e,a)

💡 How to check: Is it A E I O U? → VOWEL. Everything else → CONSONANT.
grammarZh: 英语字母表有26个字母。元音是 A E I O U（5个）— 发音时嘴巴张开，气流自由流出。辅音是其余21个字母 — 发音时嘴唇、牙齿或舌头会阻断气流。记住：每个英语单词都必须有至少一个元音！

homework.eg: A is for Apple, Ant, Arm, Angel.
homework.egZh: A代表苹果、蚂蚁、手臂、天使。

homework.eg: E is for Egg, Eat, Elephant, Every.
I is for Ice, Ink, Insect, Island.
O is for Orange, Open, Oven, Ocean.
homework.egZh: O代表橙子、打开、烤箱、海洋。

homework.eg: U is for Umbrella, Under, Up, Useful.
homework.egZh: U代表雨伞、在下面、向上、有用。

homework.eg: B, C, D, F are consonants. They need a vowel partner.
homework.egZh: B、C、D、F是辅音。它们需要一个元音伙伴。

homework.eg: The English alphabet has 26 letters.
A is the first letter. Z is the last letter.
homework.egZh: A是第一个字母。Z是最后一个字母。

comic.text: Mama, say A E I O U with me!
A... E... I... O... U! What are these?
These are VOWELS! Every word needs them. Without A E I O U, we cannot make words!
Ahhh! So cat has A, egg has E, big has I! I understand now! 明白了！

sentences.zh: A E I O U 是元音。
每个词都需要一个元音。

story.title: The Five Vowel Friends 五个元音朋友
story.text: There are five [vowel] friends in the English alphabet. They are A, E, I, O and U. They are very [important] because every English [word] needs at least one of them. [Apple] starts with A. [Elephant] starts with E. [Insect] starts with I. [Orange] starts with O. [Umbrella] starts with U. The other 21 letters are called [consonants]. Vowels and consonants work [together] to make beautiful English words!

grammar: CVC words follow a pattern: Consonant + Vowel + Consonant. For example: C-A-T, H-A-T, C-U-P. Sound out each letter, then blend them together. This is how you read new English words!
grammarZh: CVC单词遵循一个规律：辅音+元音+辅音。例如：C-A-T，H-A-T，C-U-P。把每个字母的音拼在一起，这就是你读新英语单词的方法！

title: Sight Words Set 1
objective: Recognise and use the most common English words instantly without sounding out.
objectiveZh: 立即认出并使用最常见的英语单词，无需逐字拼读。

homework.eg: The cat is on the table.

I am Mama.

grammar: Sight words are the most common words in English. We learn to recognise them instantly — not sound them out. 'A' is used before consonants (a cat, a bag). 'An' is used before vowels (an apple, an umbrella).
grammarZh: 常见词是英语中最常见的单词。我们学会立即认出它们——不需要拼读。'A'用在辅音前（a cat, a bag）。'An'用在元音前（an apple, an umbrella）。

grammar: Pronouns replace nouns. Instead of saying 'Mama' again and again, we say 'she'. I = me. You = the person I'm talking to. He/She = one other person. We = me + others. They = other people.

He is for men and boys. She is for women and girls!

title: Greetings & Polite Words
objective: Greet people correctly at different times of day and use polite words confidently.
objectiveZh: 在一天中不同时间正确问候人们，自信地使用礼貌用语。

homework.eg: Good morning! Did you sleep well?

grammar: We use different greetings for different times of day. Morning (6am–12pm) = Good morning. Afternoon (12pm–6pm) = Good afternoon. Evening (6pm–9pm) = Good evening. Bedtime = Good night. Polite words make people happy to help you!
grammarZh: 我们在一天中的不同时间使用不同的问候语。早上（6点-12点）=早上好。下午（12点-6点）=下午好。晚上（6点-9点）=晚上好。睡觉时=晚安。礼貌用语让人乐意帮助你！

story.title: A Polite Day 有礼貌的一天
story.text: Mama wakes up early. '[Good] morning!' she says to her husband. At the market she says '[Excuse] me, how much is this?' The seller smiles. 'Five dollars.' '[Thank] you!' says Mama. At night she says '[Good] night' to everyone. People love Mama because she is always [polite].

grammar: A NOUN is a naming word — a person, place or thing. Family nouns name the people in our family. In English, we always use a capital letter for 'I' but NOT for family words unless they are used as a name (Mum, Dad).

title: Articles — a, an, the
objective: Use a, an and the correctly in sentences.

homework.eg: I have a bag. I see a cat.

grammar: Use 'A' before consonant sounds: a cat, a bag, a table. Use 'AN' before vowel sounds: an apple, an egg, an umbrella, an orange. Use 'THE' when both speaker and listener know which specific thing: Pass me THE salt (we both know which salt).
grammarZh: 在辅音音前用'A'：a cat, a bag, a table。在元音音前用'AN'：an apple, an egg, an umbrella, an orange。当说话者和听者都知道指的是哪个特定的东西时用'THE'：把盐递给我（我们都知道是哪个盐）。

sentences.zh: 我有一把雨伞和一个包。

title: Singular & Plural
objective: Know the difference between one thing and many things, and form plurals correctly.
objectiveZh: 了解一个东西和多个东西的区别，正确构成复数形式。

homework.eg: I have one cat. She has three cats.
homework.egZh: 我有一只猫。她有三只猫。

homework.eg: I carry one bag. They carry two bags.
homework.egZh: 我背一个包。他们背两个包。

homework.eg: I see one bus. There are three buses.
homework.egZh: 我看见一辆巴士。有三辆巴士。

homework.eg: She washes one dish. I wash all the dishes.
homework.egZh: 她洗一个碟子。我洗所有的碟子。

homework.eg: One child is playing. Three children are playing.
homework.egZh: 一个孩子在玩。三个孩子在玩。

homework.eg: One man is here. Two men are here.

homework.eg: One woman is cooking. Three women are cooking.

homework.eg: I catch one fish. She catches ten fish.
homework.egZh: 我抓一条鱼。她抓十条鱼。

grammar: SINGULAR = one thing. PLURAL = more than one. Rules: 1) Most words: add -S (cat→cats). 2) Words ending in s,sh,ch,x: add -ES (bus→buses, dish→dishes). 3) Irregular: child→children, man→men, woman→women, fish→fish.
grammarZh: 单数=一个东西。复数=多于一个。规则：1）大多数单词：加-S（cat→cats）。2）以s,sh,ch,x结尾的单词：加-ES（bus→buses, dish→dishes）。3）不规则：child→children, man→men, woman→women, fish→fish。

title: Simple Sentences & Punctuation
objective: Build complete sentences and use capital letters, full stops and question marks correctly.
objectiveZh: 构建完整的句子，正确使用大写字母、句号和问号。

homework.eg: A sentence starts with a capital letter.
homework.egZh: 一个句子以大写字母开头。

homework.eg: Every sentence starts with a Capital Letter.
homework.egZh: 每个句子都以大写字母开头。

homework.eg: A sentence ends with a full stop.
A question ends with a question mark?
I am happy. 'I' is the subject.
I cook every day. 'Cook' is the verb.
homework.egZh: 我每天做饭。'做饭'是动词。

homework.eg: I cook rice. 'Rice' is the object.
I have a cat, a dog and a fish.
homework.egZh: 我有一只猫、一只狗和一条鱼。

grammar: A complete sentence needs: 1) A SUBJECT (who/what) + 2) A VERB (action). Example: I (subject) + cook (verb). Rules: Always start with a CAPITAL LETTER. End statements with a FULL STOP (.). End questions with a QUESTION MARK (?).
grammarZh: 一个完整的句子需要：1）主语（谁/什么）+ 2）动词（动作）。例如：我（主语）+做饭（动词）。规则：总是以大写字母开头。陈述句以句号（.）结尾。问句以问号（?）结尾。

grammar: We use colours, numbers and shapes as ADJECTIVES — they describe nouns. In English, adjectives come BEFORE the noun: a RED bag (not 'a bag red'). We can combine them: a small RED ROUND plate.
grammarZh: 我们将颜色、数字和形状用作形容词——它们描述名词。在英语中，形容词放在名词之前：一个红色的包（不是'一个包红色的'）。我们可以组合它们：一个小的红色圆形盘子。

title: Putting It All Together
objective: Build complete sentences using everything learned in P1.
objectiveZh: 用P1学到的所有知识构建完整的句子。

homework.eg: I am happy because I am learning.
homework.egZh: 我很开心因为我在学习。

homework.eg: I have a cat and a dog.
I am tired but I will keep going.
I am very happy today!
I practise English every day.
She is very kind and patient.
I also have a green cup.
homework.egZh: 我也有一个绿色的杯子。

homework.eg: I can speak English now!

grammar: Now we can build longer sentences by joining ideas: I am tired BUT I will keep going. I have a cat AND a dog. I am happy BECAUSE I am learning. These joining words are called CONJUNCTIONS.
grammarZh: 现在我们可以用连接词造更长的句子：我很累但是我会继续。我有一只猫和一只狗。我很开心因为我在学习。这些连接词叫做连词。

sentences.zh: 我很开心因为我在学习英语。

story.title: I Can Do This! 我能做到！
story.text: Mama looks at what she has [learned]. She knows her [vowels] and [consonants]. She can read [simple] words. She knows her [greetings] and [polite] words. She can write a [sentence] with a capital letter and full stop. She is [very] proud. '[Now] I can speak a little English!' she says. '[And] I will keep learning!'

comic.text: Mama, tell me about yourself in English!
I am Mama. I have one daughter and I love her very much. I am happy because I am learning English now!
That was a PERFECT paragraph Mama! I am so proud of you! 🎉

title: P1 Review & Test
objective: Review everything from P1 and pass the checkpoint test to unlock Primary 2.
objectiveZh: 复习P1的所有内容，通过检查点测试解锁小学二年级。

homework.eg: A E I O U are vowels.
One cat, two cats.
Use a, an, the correctly.
I, you, he, she, we, they.
Start with capital, end with full stop.
homework.egZh: 以大写字母开头，以句号结尾。

homework.eg: Red, big, round — describe nouns.
And, but, because join ideas.
Cat, mother, table — naming words.

grammar: P1 Review: Vowels (A E I O U), Articles (a/an/the), Pronouns (I/you/he/she/we/they), Singular/Plural, Simple sentences with capital letters and full stops, Colours/Numbers/Shapes as adjectives, Conjunctions (and/but/because).
grammarZh: P1复习：元音（AEIOU）、冠词（a/an/the）、代词（I/you/he/she/we/they）、单数/复数、带大写字母和句号的简单句子、颜色/数字/形状作为形容词、连词（and/but/because）。
